answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond that unlocks only after established peers grade its answers across a full epoch. One pulse of good work proves nothing; like a tide, standing has to return cycle after cycle before it counts. A farmer spinning a spiral of sockpuppets must fund and season a separate bond for every fake, and when one fake is exposed, every linked bond burns with it — so the attack costs more than honest participation ever pays.
